<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Individual player responses lack a scope field. Only aggregate responses include scope: "all".

The frontend checks `stats?.scope === "all"` via `isAllPlayersScope` to identify aggregate scope. The default `/spieler` route renders "Alle Spieler" and calls `/player/get_lifetime_stats?season=all`, routing to the backend aggregate path. Tournament and game data both originate from a single backend endpoint, `/player/get_lifetime_stats`, which sources all player game rows from `data_manager.df`.
</details></think>

## `/spieler` (no player selected) — architecture map

Default URL: `/spieler` (optionally `?database=…`). No `player_name` / `player_id` → **all-players scope** (“Alle Spieler”).

---

### 1. “Beste Turniere” — where & data flow

| Layer | File | Role |
|-------|------|------|
| **UI render** | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\player\blocks\PlayerHighlights.tsx` | Category `bestTournaments` (lines 103–108); title via i18n key `ui.player.highlights_best_tournaments` / fallback `"Beste Turniere"` |
| **Data build** | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\playerHighlights.ts` | `buildPlayerHighlights()` → `bestTournaments` (lines 231–269) |
| **Page wiring** | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\player\PlayerStats.tsx` | Passes `scope="all"`, `playerCompetitions={stats.player_competitions}` (lines 197–205) |
| **i18n** | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\app\services\i18n_service.py` | `"ui.player.highlights_best_tournaments"` → `"Beste Turniere"` |

**All-players logic** (`playerHighlights.ts`):
- Source rows: `input.playerCompetitions` (not `seasons`)
- Filter: `is_tournament === true` **and** `rank` is finite
- Sort: ascending `rank`, then season (newer first)
- Top **10** (`PLAYER_HIGHLIGHTS_TOP_N`)
- **Label**: player name; **value**: `"rank / competitors"`; **detail**: abbreviated tournament name · season · club; **href**: `/spieler?player_name=…&player_id=…`

**Backend origin**: `player_competitions` is built in `PlayerService._build_aggregate_lifetime_stats_from_games()` (`c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\app\services\player_service.py`, ~1440–1456), one row per player × competition; tournament rows get `is_tournament: true` and `rank`/`competitors` from `_tournament_competition_rank_table()`.

---

### 2. Components

| Name | Path | Purpose on all-players `/spieler` |
|------|------|-----------------------------------|
| **`PlayerStats`** | `frontend\src\pages\player\PlayerStats.tsx` | Page shell; route in `App.tsx` line 37; fetches data, renders blocks when `stats.lifetime` exists |
| **`LifetimeStats`** | `frontend\src\pages\player\blocks\LifetimeStats.tsx` | “Karrierestatistik / Gesamtwerte”; shows aggregate totals + best game/season with `player_name` when `allPlayersScope` |
| **`PlayerHighlights`** | `frontend\src\pages\player\blocks\PlayerHighlights.tsx` | Highlight grid (“Highlights — alle Spieler”); calls `buildPlayerHighlights()` |

Also on the page (not asked, but relevant): `CompetitionBreakdownCharts`, `TrendChart`.

**Types/hooks**: `frontend\src\hooks\usePlayer.ts` — `PlayerStatsResponse`, `PlayerSeasonRow`, `PlayerPeriodRow`, `isAllPlayersScope()`, `usePlayerLifetimeStats()`.

### 3. Backend endpoints (aggregate / all-players)

There is **one main data endpoint** for this page; tournament vs league is distinguished inside the payload, not via separate routes.

| Endpoint | When (no player) | Handler |
|----------|------------------|---------|
| **`GET /player/get_lifetime_stats`** | `season=all`, no `player_name`/`player_id` | `app\routes\player_routes.py` → `get_aggregate_lifetime_stats()` or merged season caches |
| `GET /player/search` | Player picker | `search_players()` |
| `GET /player/get_available_seasons` | Season chips (empty when no player) | `get_available_seasons()` |

**Service**: `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\app\services\player_service.py`

- **Game source**: `_subset_all_player_games()` → full `data_manager.df` (all scored player rows)
- **Tournament vs game/competition split** (same endpoint, different arrays/flags):

| Field | Content | Tournament vs league |
|-------|---------|----------------------|
| `scope` | `"all"` | Marks aggregate mode |
| `lifetime` | Totals, best game, best season, most improved (with `player_name` where relevant) | From all game rows |
| `seasons` | Per-competition **aggregate** rows (`row_type: "competition"`, no `player_name`) | `is_tournament` per row; feeds charts |
| `player_competitions` | Per-player × competition rows | `is_tournament` + `rank`/`competitors`; feeds **Beste Turniere** / **Beste Wettbewerbe** |
| `player_season_totals` | Per-player season aggregates (`row_type: "season_total"`) | Feeds **Schnitt nach Saison** |
| `periods` | Per matchday (`period_kind: "week"`) or tournament round (`period_kind: "round"`) | `_build_period_stats()` splits on `event_type === "tournament"`; feeds **Beste Spieltage** |

No separate `/player/tournament_*` or game-level endpoint is used on this page.

**Example all-players response shape** (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "scope": "all",
  "lifetime": {
    "total_games": 12345,
    "total_pins": 2345678,
    "average_score": 189.45,
    "best_game": { "score": 300, "date": "tbd", "event": "Player · Season Event Week 3" },
    "best_season": { "season": "2024/25", "average": 205.1, "player_name": "…" },
    "most_improved": { "season": "…", "improvement": 12.5, "player_name": "…" }
  },
  "seasons": [ { "row_type": "competition", "competition": "…", "is_tournament": false, "games": …, "average": … } ],
  "player_competitions": [ { "row_type": "competition", "player_name": "…", "player_id": "…", "is_tournament": true, "rank": 2, "competitors": 48, "competition": "…", "season": "…", "club": "…" } ],
  "player_season_totals": [ { "row_type": "season_total", "player_name": "…", "season": "…", "average": …, "games": … } ],
  "periods": [ { "row_type": "period", "period_kind": "week"|"round", "player_name": "…", "is_tournament": false|true, "average": … } ]
}
```

### 4. Navbar “Start” category (frontend)

**File**: `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\Sidebar.tsx`

`NAV_GROUPS` constant (lines 45–79):

```45:50:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\Sidebar.tsx
const NAV_GROUPS: ReadonlyArray<NavGroupDef> = [
  {
    labelKey: "ui.nav.group_start",
    fallback: "Start",
    items: [{ path: "/", labelKey: "ui.nav.home", fallback: "Übersicht", icon: HomeIcon }],
  },
```

- **Group label**: `ui.nav.group_start` → “Start” (`i18n_service.py`)
- **Single item**: `/` → “Übersicht” (`ui.nav.home`), `HomeIcon`
- Other groups: **Spielbetrieb** (`/liga`, `/turnier`), **Akteure** (`/club`, `/spieler`), **Diagnose** (design-system, club-matrix, etc.)
- Links append `querySuffixForPath()` so `?database=…` persists (`navigationQuery.ts`)

### Highlights data shape (`PlayerHighlightEntry`)

From `playerHighlights.ts`:

```typescript
type PlayerHighlightEntry = {
  id: string;
  label: string;      // all-players Beste Turniere: player name
  value: string;      // e.g. "2 / 48"
  detail?: string;    // tournament abbrev · season · club
  href?: string;      // /spieler?player_name=…&player_id=…
  title?: string;     // full competition name (tooltip)
};

type PlayerHighlightsData = {
  clubAffiliation: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  gamesByClub: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  avgByClub: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  avgBySeason: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  bestTournaments: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  bestCompetitions: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
  bestDays: PlayerHighlightEntry[];
};
```
